one_line_description: Stripe API provides a suite of payment APIs for online businesses of all sizes.
auth_notes: API keys are used to authenticate requests, with test mode secret keys starting with sk_test_ and live mode secret keys starting with rk_live_
api_access_pricing: free to use, with some limitations

evidence.quote_snippet: The Stripe API is organized around REST. Our API has predictable resource-oriented URLs, accepts form-encoded request bodies, returns JSON-encoded responses, and uses standard HTTP response codes, authentication, and verbs.
The Stripe API uses API keys to authenticate requests. You can view and manage your API keys in the Stripe Dashboard.
Stripe publishes 71 API contracts indexed on the APIs.io network, including Accounts API, Balance API, Charges API, and 68 more.
